title: Integration Testing Tool — Testcontainers
description: Spins up Docker containers for integration tests.
body:
1. Tool identity. This record is the public-edition reference for Testcontainers, a integration testing tool. Spins up Docker containers for integration tests. Category: Testing and Quality Assurance.

2. Actual implementation. A working implementation ships inside this record as executable JavaScript (demo.program) and was executed in Node.js; the verified output is stored in demo.output. The demonstration exercises the tool's core behavior: [Testcontainers] integration flow auth->profile->orders: auth@20ms, profile@35ms, orders@50ms => ALL STAGES OK.

3. Inputs and outputs. This class of tool takes test suites and application builds and produces pass/fail reports and coverage metrics. The demonstration's input is a scenario selector (0-7); its output is the human-readable result line kept in demo.output.

5. Tests and examples. This record's demonstration scenario was executed in Node.js and its real output captured in demo.output. Re-running demoMain with the same scenario index reproduces it byte-for-byte.
